$comment: Project profile for the canon-shipped harness (tools/harness in the sza plugin), written 2026-10-29 when the project joined the task-flow ledger (owner order: every project in the ledger, worked by the portfolio runner). Only what differs from the canon defaults is here. Ticket files are docs/specifications/<id>_<slug>.md; a file written there without a ledger row is registered by the portfolio queue sync (TASK-FLOW rule 65). Since 2026-11-19 paths.releaseQueue / releaseReady / releaseQueueDone name the owner's RELEASE_QUEUE.md, RELEASE_READY.md and RELEASE_QUEUE_DONE.md, which the plan tool re-renders from the ledger on every catalog write. The pq workaround is gone (L0367, 2026-11-19): the canon queue reader accepts L#### rows through grammar.ticketIdPattern (sza-unified-rules S0149), so the pq registry record of this project (~/.sza/portfolio/repos.json) carries no releaseQueue key and pq reads docs/specifications/RELEASE_QUEUE.md. A registry record that names the ledger again would make the robots take tickets in ledger order instead of the owner's order. Ticket ids: since 2026-11-19 (ticket FMSWIN-0368, formerly L0368) a new ticket is FMSWIN-#### (grammar.ticketIdPattern) and the numbers continue after the highest old one; the old L#### shape stays valid for closed tickets through grammar.legacyTicketIdPatterns, and every renamed ticket keeps its old id in the ledger field formerIds.
